title: Medical Records Requests Turnaround Schedule
content:
Each Medical Records Requests type carries its own turnaround figures. The response period is the number of calendar days after the request is received — or, where an authorization is needed, after it is signed — by which the records are delivered. An extension adds its calendar days to the due date, and the extension count is the number of extensions permitted per request.

## Response period and extensions

| Request type | Response period (calendar days) | Days one extension adds (calendar days) | Extensions permitted per request | Longest period with every permitted extension (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portal Self-Service Download | 1 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| Patient Electronic Copy Request | 30 | 30 | 1 | 60 |
| Patient Paper Copy Request | 30 | 30 | 1 | 60 |
| Provider-to-Provider Transfer | 10 | 0 | 0 | 10 |
| Third-Party Authorized Release | 30 | 30 | 1 | 60 |
| Certified Legal Records Package | 30 | 30 | 1 | 60 |
| Imaging Disc Copy Request | 15 | 15 | 1 | 30 |

The last column is the response period plus the days of each permitted extension; for example, the Imaging Disc Copy Request's 15 days plus one extension of 15 days gives 30 days.

## Expedited processing, status updates and portal availability

The expedited period is counted in business days; a figure of 0 means no expedite. Status updates are given to the requester at the stated interval of business days while the request is open. Portal availability is the number of hours after a note or result is finalized that it appears for portal download.

| Request type | Expedite offered | Expedited period (business days) | Status update interval (business days) | Portal availability (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portal Self-Service Download | No | 0 | 0 | 72 |
| Patient Electronic Copy Request | Yes | 3 | 10 | 0 |
| Patient Paper Copy Request | Yes | 5 | 10 | 0 |
| Provider-to-Provider Transfer | Yes | 1 | 3 | 0 |
| Third-Party Authorized Release | Yes | 5 | 10 | 0 |
| Certified Legal Records Package | Yes | 5 | 10 | 0 |
| Imaging Disc Copy Request | Yes | 3 | 5 | 0 |

## Reading the schedule

- A type showing 0 extensions permitted takes no extension; the Portal Self-Service Download and the Provider-to-Provider Transfer are such types.
- The Portal Self-Service Download is the only type on which expedite is not offered, and its expedited period is 0.
- Expedited periods are counted in business days, while response periods and extensions are counted in calendar days.
